kill %1

events.content:
Done. Dependency-free Node app, run with `npm start` → http://localhost:3000

- `server.js` — routes and server-rendered pages: `/` lists currently reading + finished with an add form, `POST /books` adds, `POST /books/:id/finish` marks done, `/books/:id` is the shareable per-book page (title, author, notes)
- `lib/store.js` — CRUD backed by `books.json` (atomic write, survives restarts, gitignored)
- `test/store.test.js` — 4 vitest tests, all passing; routes verified end-to-end with curl

No framework, no accounts, escaped HTML throughout.

shellCommands.command:
node server.js & sleep 1
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET / -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
curl -s -X POST --data-urlencode "title=Dune" --data-urlencode "author=Frank Herbert" --data-urlencode "notes=Spicy." -o /dev/null -w "POST /books -> %{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3000/books
BOOK=$(curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '/books/[a-f0-9-]*' | head -1)
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET $BOOK -> %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3000$BOOK"
curl -s -X POST -o /dev/null -w "POST $BOOK/finish -> %{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" "http://localhost:3000$BOOK/finish"
curl -s "http://localhost:3000$BOOK" | grep -o "Finished [A-Za-z]* [0-9]*, [0-9]*"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /books/missing -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/missing
kill %1

node server.js & sleep 1
BOOK=$(curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '/books/[a-f0-9-]*' | head -1)
curl -s "http://localhost:3000$BOOK" | grep -oE "(Currently reading|Finished [^<]*)"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -c "Mark finished"
kill %1; cat books.json
